chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Weeknight jams and weekend shows at the Paradise
summary: Monday to Thursday were jam nights for musicians, with a small show on the weekend; he hired Gene Ammons or Monk for Mondays.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How many nights did you work, yourself?
Yeah. No, I was off Monday. Yeah, but I hired the guys for Monday night, you know
what I mean. So sometimes Monday night would be Gene Ammons and another night would be Monk and then the guys would come by Monday and jam too, you know, and so we had a thing goin'. Yeah.
